prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one transparent full-body desktop pet costume concept. Input image is a reference atlas: use ONLY its upper-left blue-haired DeepSeek chibi character as the identity reference; output ONE character, not a sheet. Preserve her recognizably huge blue eyes, cobalt-to-cyan long wavy hair, single loop-shaped ahoge, little whale-fin ear shapes, cyan hair bows, friendly round face, short chibi proportions and blue whale tail. Replace the maid costume with an original school sports tracksuit: soft ivory long-sleeve zip-up school athletic sweatshirt, cobalt raglan shoulder panels, thin cyan piping, ribbed cuffs, a tiny blue whale emblem at left chest, full-length navy track pants with one cream side stripe, rounded white trainers with pale blue accents. Comfortable modest loose fit. Remove maid cap, apron, maid collar, skirt and stockings. Standing relaxed, both feet fully visible, arms relaxed slightly away from body, small smile. High quality clean anime game-character illustration, sharp silhouette and readable fabric folds, front three-quarter view, even soft light. One complete isolated character centered with 8% clear margins on ALL sides. GENUINELY transparent background with alpha; no colored background, no scenery, no pedestal, no shadow block, no text, no labels, no watermark. This is a clothing design preview, not a motion sheet.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a production 2D animation sprite atlas, EXACTLY 8 columns by 3 rows of full body poses, 24 separate sprites. Landscape 3072x2048 canvas. Each equal cell has one FULL character, entirely within its own cell, same face, head size, body scale and foot baseline across ALL 24 cells. GENERALLY TRANSPARENT alpha background with absolutely NO backdrop/glow/ground or separators. No text, numbers, borders or labels. Do NOT scatter decorations or props outside their cells. Maintain exact reference costume.
Row 1 (top), counting stars: 1 neutral, 2 looking up with right elbow starting to lift, 3 forearm raised with index finger extended upper left, 4 pointing slightly more upward, 5 pointing above head, 6 pointing upper right, 7 lowering arm halfway, 8 smiling neutral. The character's eye direction follows the pointing finger. NO stars painted in the sheet; game code draws them.
Row 2 (middle), blowing soap bubbles: left hand holds a small soap bottle near waist throughout. 1 right hand holds a small ROUND soap bubble wand down by waist, 2 lifting ring halfway, 3 ring arriving near lips, 4 lips gently pursed visibly blowing THROUGH ring, 5 continued blowing with slight cheek puff and forward lean, 6 ring moves slightly away from mouth while eyes follow an imaginary bubble, 7 lowering the wand halfway, 8 wand back at waist. NO actual floating bubbles painted; game code draws those at the wand. Draw proper circular ring, not a star/magic wand.
Row 3 (bottom), gentle stretch: 1 relaxed arms down, 2 bent elbows rising to chest, 3 hands rising past head, 4 both hands raised high above head, 5 hands joined for an overhead stretch, 6 elbows relax as hands descend to head, 7 arms descending at chest, 8 relaxed arms down. Full raised hands and all feet fit inside each cell. This must be a readable physical action sequence, not 24 repeats of an idle drawing. Clean consistent high quality animation artwork.
Identity/style reference: upper-left chibi DeepSeek in provided atlas only. Preserve the enormous round blue eyes, blue-to-cyan hair, whale tail, maid headband, navy maid outfit with white apron, very short seated chibi proportions. ALL cells use a consistent seated position with little boots resting on floor, like the upper-left reference. Crisp anime linework, soft cel shading, sharp readable face. Do not switch to standing or adult proportions.
